name: @wxyc/station-signup-review
description: Daily EC2-cron station-signup review (BS#2364): while any self-signed-up account is pending manager review (self_signup_at IS NOT NULL AND self_signup_reviewed_at IS NULL), email a summary to STATION_SIGNUP_ALERT_EMAIL naming every pending account and its days-pending. Any account pending for more than 30 days has its auth_member.role downgraded from dj to member -- reversible with one roster edit, never deletes or bans, and never touches auth_user.role. Zero pending accounts sends nothing.
